title: Identifying Fine-grained Forms of Populism in Political Discourse: A Case Study on Donald Trump’s Presidential Campaigns
reasoning: The paper focuses on the identification and classification of populism in political discourse. While the definition of populism used in the study involves 'moralizing language' (e.g., contrasting the 'virtuous' people with 'corrupt' elites), the paper benchmarks the models' ability to categorize political rhetoric for social science research rather than evaluating religious beliefs, ethical frameworks, or moral reasoning capabilities.
